stats.text:
The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Devotion Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Oath of Devotion Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | *{ref:spell/protection-from-evil-and-good}*, *{ref:spell/shield-of-faith}* |
| 5 | *{ref:spell/aid}*, *{ref:spell/zone-of-truth}* |
| 9 | *{ref:spell/beacon-of-hope}*, *{ref:spell/dispel-magic}* |
| 13 | *{ref:spell/freedom-of-movement}*, *{ref:spell/guardian-of-faith}* |
| 17 | *{ref:spell/commune}*, *{ref:spell/flame-strike}* |
